assumptions_and_scope: Positive finite chain lengths, one reflexive binary order predicate and equality; no named coordinate orders; ordinary first-order quantifier rank at most three, without counting.
description: The coordinatewise partial orders on finite nonempty products of two chains have exactly 21 equivalence classes in first-order logic of quantifier rank at most three. The least uniform cardinality of class representatives is 30, attained at the five-by-six product.
scientific_integrity: No claim of independent proof certification. Exact nested finite EF types were computed independently by two reproducible standard-library programs, and the uniform unbounded reduction is established mathematically.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify higher-rank theories, signatures naming factors, or counting logic. Complete finite enumeration is combined with an independent infinite order-product reduction. Searches cannot establish absolute historical priority; independent validation is not performed.
title: Twenty-one three-round theories of two-chain product lattices
